newsCard.title: 📍⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️📍
newsCard.body:
On June 24th, an earthquake occurred that severely affected me; due to this, the loss of progress, damage to my equipment, and not having a proper place or the necessary tools, it was impossible for me to handle icon requests during all this time. I have barely been able to start resuming work with very few resources and space, but despite all the difficulties, I am here giving my absolute all to respond to you responsibly and move forward.

For users who are already aware of this situation, and given the high volume and demand of accumulated requests, the following measures will be implemented to work in an orderly manner:

Notice to new users: If you are new here and this message catches you by surprise, we sincerely apologize for coming across this announcement right away; we are currently going through an exceptional situation of force majeure.

Frequency and priority: Requests will not be processed with the same frequency as before, and priority will be given to premium requests.

Periodic opening and closing: The request button (for both free and premium requests) will be periodically enabled and disabled with the sole purpose of processing and catching up on pending requests from existing users.

Individual verification: Each request will be rigorously reviewed one by one to verify its legitimacy; if necessary, we will contact you via email to validate the information.

Thank you in advance for your immense patience, understanding, and support as we work through this process to bring you new versions very soon
